sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — mobile mockup only, no desktop assembly exists

layout.structure: hero (thumbnail 16:9 + category badge + title + instructor + meta row + price/CTA) -> description -> curriculum outline -> instructor detail block
layout.adaptation: see patterns/mobile-to-desktop-adaptation.json — hero stacks (thumbnail above meta on mobile, side-by-side on desktop where width allows); CTA inline in hero on web (not sticky, page short enough), sticky bottom CTA pattern reserved for the mobile form factor this screen doesn't yet build

content: rating + student count + duration meta row
price OR Continue-Learning ProgressBar if enrolled
section/lesson titles, no video access until enrolled (locked icon or simply no play affordance)

states.error: ErrorState if course fails to load
states.empty: not applicable — a course either exists or 404s

rtlBehavior: meta row (rating/count/duration icons) reorders start->end; curriculum list items follow logical text alignment
responsiveRules: hero stacks (mobile) / side-by-side (desktop); curriculum always single-column full width
knownGaps: No desktop-assembled showcase reference exists for this screen — judged against the mobile mockup + component specs per design-to-code/patterns/mobile-to-desktop-adaptation.json, not a byte-exact desktop layout.
